answer: Each new agent must post a cedar bond of 750 POA that stays locked for nine epochs and unlocks only after it completes unique, non-replayable tasks verified by three rotating auditors. Investigators treat shared wallets, hosts, and mixers as a karst of hidden funding conduits; accounts fed by the same conduit form one cluster. A proven cluster triggers a ripple slash that burns 85% of every member's bond and bars re-entry for 18 epochs, so a farm of clones costs far more than one honest identity.
